title: does partial coverage of Pfam invalidate SwissProt cutoffs
body: At full SwissProt 9,409 of 20,795 families get a cutoff and the count is still climbing steeply (5,567 at 100k, 7,662 at 250k) while the median barely moves (nail 11.3 at 10k to 14.8 at all, across a 57x pool). Either SwissProt is too small a decoy pool to cover Pfam, or a family that never recruits anything needs no cutoff and partial coverage is correct. Which holds decides whether SwissProt cutoffs are promotable or only a check on the MGnify ones.
